learning_objective: 🎯 To discover that quick thinking, calmness, and intelligence can help us solve the most difficult problems!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A big problem suddenly appears, causing everyone around to panic and worry. Nobody knows what to do to fix the scary situation.
While others are scared, Rama stays very calm. He knows that getting nervous will not help, so he uses his brain to think of a smart idea.
Rama quickly creates a brilliant strategy. He uses the things around him and his sharp wit to turn the situation around completely.
Because of Rama's brave and smart actions, the problem is solved and everyone is saved! It shows that brainpower is the best superpower.

fun_activity.title: 🎭 Be a Problem Solver!
fun_activity.instructions: Think of a time when you or a friend got stuck in a tricky situation. Write down the clever idea you used to get out of it!

quick_recap: ⭐ A dangerous situation caused panic among the people.
⭐ Rama did not get scared but stayed incredibly calm.
⭐ He used his intelligence to create a fast and clever plan.
⭐ His quick thinking rescued everyone from danger.
